name: Bad Llama
details:
Lava Spit: 13+F to hit, 1d8+3 Fire, 30ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the target gains the
Burning Debuff.
Notes: Bad Reflux—Attacks can target the lava pouch
in the Llama’s throat during rounds when it uses Lava
Spit, but this adds a +2 to the Llama’s Evade. The pouch
ruptures if such an Attack deals damage, killing the
Llama and setting its corpse aflame.

name: Brain Boiler
details:
Bite: 12+F to hit, 3d4+2 Piercing, 5ft range
Flying Face Hug: 14+F to hit, No damage, 15ft range
Any hit crawler must make a Str Stat Check. On a Fail,
they gain the Wrapped Debuff: Their head is covered by
the Brain Boiler and they gain the Burned Debuff until the
creature is killed or removed. It cannot be extinguished
as per the Burned Debuff rules.
Notes: Wrapped—As an action, a crawler with the
Wrapped Debuff may make a Str‑Opposed Escape Artist
Skill Check, or a Str Stat Check at the same Difficulty to
escape. Attacks against the Brain Boiler by anyone other
than the affected crawler do half their damage to the
crawler and half to the Brain Boiler.

name: Bugaboo
details:
Boo Hug: 15+F to hit, 3d8+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Held Debuff.

name: City Elves
details:
Butterfly Knife: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Piercing, 5ft range,
Armor‑Piercing
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Desert Eagle: 14+F to hit, 3d6 Piercing, 50ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler is pushed 10ft.
Notes: Fanatical—City Elves are immune to fear, charm,
and mind‑affecting effects.

name: Village Guard
details:
Commanding Shout Spell: 15+F to hit, No damage,
100ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Terrified Debuff for 2 rounds.
Longsword: 16+F to hit, 7d10+6 Slashing, 5ft range
Notes: Letter of the Law—Village Guards don’t compro‑
mise or show mercy. If they know someone has broken
a law, they attempt to kill the target on sight. They end
their pursuit if the target leaves the settlement but re‑
member the target if they return.

name: Grulke
details:
Polearm: 14+F to hit, 3d8+4 Slashing, 10ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Slam: 14+F to hit, 3d8+4 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Take Down Debuff.
Tongue: 14+F to hit, 2d6+4 Poison, 20ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Paralyzed Debuff.
Notes: Great Leaper—Grulke can leap a distance equal
to their Move.

name: Over City Skyfowl
details:
Crossbow: 14+F to hit, 3d6 Piercing, 30ft range
Spear: 14+F to hit, 3d8+4 Piercing, 10ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Grab: 14+F to hit, No damage, 5ft range
Any crawler hit gains the Held Debuff.
Notes: Catch and Release—Held crawlers are flown to a
height of 30 feet and dropped the next round.
Flight—Over City Skyfowl can move through the air as
though on the ground.
Riled Up—During the first round of combat, Over City
Skyfowl add their Stat Mod to damage a second time.

name: Cat Girl
details:
Claw: 14+F to hit, 3d4+4 Slashing, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Hairball: 15+F to hit, 3d6 Acid, 20ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Burned Debuff.
Tail Lash: 14+F to hit, 3d4+4 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Take Down Debuff.
Notes: Klepto—Cat Girls can’t be trusted, obviously.
Crawlers encountering a Cat Girl for the first time must
make an Int Stat Check. On Fail, the crawler loses one
low value item they are wearing without realizing it.
Pheromones—Cat Girls secrete a pheromone that makes
others agreeable with them. Crawlers that join a party
with a Cat Girl must make an Int Stat Check. On Fail, they
must comply with the first non‑harmful suggestion made
by the Cat Girl.

name: Centurion Skyfowl
details:
Aerial Head Slam: 15+F to hit, 2d10+5 Bludgeoning,
5 ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Staggered and Take Down Debuffs.
Sonic Screech: 14+F to hit, 2d10+4 Sonic, 30ft Cone,
+5ft Splash
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Terrified Debuff.
Talon Slash: 15+F to hit, 3d8+5 Slashing, 5ft range,
Armor‑Piercing
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Notes: Heavy Hitter—If Jack Screecher’s previous
attack hits a crawler, that crawler has Disadvantage on
their next Evade attempt. If Jack Screecher’s previous
attack misses a crawler, that crawler has Advantage on
their next Evade attempt.
Flight—Jack Screecher can
move through the air as
though on the ground.

name: Beat Cop
details:
Beatbox: 13+F to hit, 2d8+3 Sonic, 15ft Burst radius
Truncheon: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Notes: It’s Curtains for You—Beat Cops dance in sync
even when not attacking. Any crawler witnessing two or
more Beat Cops dancing together must make a Cha Stat
Check with a Difficulty of 10+F plus the number of Beat
Cops. On Fail, the crawler gains the Terrified Debuff.
On the Beat—Beat Cops prefer fighting in sync. When
adjacent Beat Cops perform the same attack during a
round, each one gains a +1 bonus to hit and damage for
each adjacent attacking Beat Cop, up to a maximum of
+3. When a crawler is hit for 3+ HB slots, they can make
a free Unopposed Performance Skill Check to see the
pattern. On Success, they notice the pattern and can add
their Int as a bonus to Evade these attacks. Once one
crawler notices the pattern, the remaining crawlers do
also and gain the same Int bonus.
Robot—Beat Cops are metal robots and immune to Psy‑
chic damage, but their DR is 0 against Electric attacks.
Can they bleed or be poisoned? Probably! (They bleed oil
and suffer corrosion—robots, they’re just like us!)

name: Effective Detective
details:
Gat: 14+F to hit, 2d10 Piercing, 100ft range
Lowdown Peeper (Spell): 15+F to hit, 2d4+5 Psychic,
30ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Queasy Debuff.
Punch: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Collared Debuff: Cannot use
attacks with Rank higher than 5.
Notes: Qualified Immunity—An Effective Detective’s
badge expands into a body‑length shield when wielded,
adding a +2 DR Buff against foes directly in front of
them. Multiple Effective Detectives can stand side by
side, forming a phalanx that increases this bonus to +4
but reduces their Step to 0ft.

name: Mook
details:
Improvised Melee Weapon: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4
Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Improvised Thrown Weapon: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4
Slashing, 20ft range
Big Fuckin’ Insult: 13+F to hit, No damage, 60ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Enraged or Terrified Debuff
(GM’s choice depending on character’s personality).
Notes: Yer Goin’ Down with Me—Mooks were dealt
bad hands in life, and their anger at the world means
they want to take everyone else down with them. When
Mooks have fewer than half of their HB slots left, they
gain the Enraged Debuff, focusing their attacks on who‑
ever last damaged them and gaining a +2 bonus to hit
and damage.

name: Gumshoe
details:
Exposé Spell: 15+F to hit, 2d8+5 Psychic, 60ft range,
15ft Blast radius
Any hit crawler must make an Int Stat Check. On Fail,
they gain the Dodgy Reputation Debuff: The crawl‑
er’s HUD is flooded with dark secrets about one other
crawler who is participating in the combat, chosen by the
Gumshoe. Any Buffs provided by the chosen crawler are
ineffective until the end of the encounter. This Debuff
stacks for each unique subject of Exposé.
Gat: 15+F to hit, 3d10 Piercing, 100ft range
Notes: Clean Sneak—Gumshoes can Hide in Shadows.
Crawlers must make an Int‑Opposed Perception Skill
Check to spot them. On Fail, the Gumshoes may success‑
fully Ambush the crawlers.
Glom a Bulge—That means “spotting an advantage” in
noir slang. Get your mind out of the gutter! A Gumshoe
can shout out advice about a target to an ally instead of
attacking, granting the ally Advantage on their attack
against the target.
Grab Air—Gumshoes can leap high into the air when
they Move, allowing them to move over occupied spaces
without triggering Interrupts and land up to 10ft higher
than their starting space.

name: Gun Doll
details:
Bean Shooter: 15+F to hit, 3d6 Piercing, 80ft range
Pocket Knife: 15+F to hit, 3d6+3Piercing, 5ft range,
Armor‑Piercing
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.

name: Torpedo
details:
Chomp: 15+F to hit, 3d8+5 Piercing, 5ft range
Submachine Gun: 14+F to hit, 2d10 Piercing, 60ft Cone
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler is pushed 10ft.
Torpedo: 15+F to hit, 2d12+5 Fire, 15ft Burst radius
Any hit crawler gains the Burned Debuff. Can be used
once per combat; deals full damage to self as well.
Notes: Blow ’Em Down—Torpedoes are out to kill their
mark, and they don’t care who else they off along the
way. Similarly, they have no problem catching allies or
bystanders in the crossfire of their submachine guns.

name: Songstress
details:
38 Special: 13+F to hit, 2d6 Piercing, 20ft range
Blow a Kiss: 12+F to hit, 2d4+2 Psychic, 10ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Woozy Debuff.
Notes: Sultry Singer—Crawlers hearing an Orc Singer
song must make an Int Stat Check. On Fail, the crawler
gains the Captivated Debuff: They cannot hear anything
else until the song ends

name: The Divider
details:
Bite: 15+F to hit, 3d10+5 Piercing, 15ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Held Debuff. The Divider has learned that diving deep
underwater after grabbing prey is a quick way to finish
them off and eat in peace. Crawlers with the Held Debuff
must make a Str‑Opposed Escape Artist Skill Check, or
a Str Stat Check at the same Difficulty. On Fail, they are
dragged underwater and gain the Drowning Debuff.
Tail Swipe: 15+F to hit, 2d10+5 Bludgeoning, 60ft Cone
The Divider’s Tail Swipe is powerful enough to generate
tsunami‑like waves even in open water in a cone that’s
60ft in length. Any boats within hit by the attack have
a 50% of capsizing, though someone piloting a boat
can attempt an appropriate Unopposed Skill Check to
prevent capsizing. On Fail, they capsize. Anyone in the
water in the area must make a Swimming Skill Check. On
Fail, they gain the Drowning Debuff.
Notes: Eating With Your Mouth Full—When a crawler
is Held in one of the Divider’s mouths, that mouth can’t
Bite without releasing the crawler; the crawler auto‑
matically moves with the Divider when it moves with no
penalties to the Divider’s Move or Step.
Easily Distracted—Decoys and dummy boats can be
used to distract the Divider. The presence of 1 or more of
these reduces the Divider’s attacks by 1 for 1d4 rounds.
Enormous Size—When the Divider is in water, it can
move into or through spaces occupied by entities or ob‑
jects smaller than itself, causing them to be pushed 10ft
in a direction perpendicular to the Divider’s movement.
The Divider has Disadvantage on attacks within 20ft of

name: Merry Militiaman
details:
Apito’s Blow: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Apito’s Double Barrel Spell: 14+F to hit, 3d4+4
Necrotic, 50ft range
Can hit up to two targets with one attack.
Apito’s Shower Spell: 14+F to hit, 2d8+4 Necrotic,
60ft range, 10ft Blast radius
Apito’s Thirst Spell: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Piercing, 30ft
range
On Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Drain Debuff: Take 1d8+F Necrotic at the end of
each round and the Merry Militiaman heals 1 HB, until the
combat ends.

name: Gobblin’ Hog
details:
Gobble: 14+F to hit, 2d8+4 Slashing, 5ft range
Any hit crawler must make a Con Stat Check. On Fail,
they immediately gain the Major Injury Debuff. This at‑
tack can only be used on targets at 20% HB or less.
Thrown Tusk: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Piercing, 30ft range
This attack can only be used at night.
Tusk: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Piercing, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail, the target loses a carried or
worn item to the Gobblin’ Hog’s stomach.
Notes: Charge!—If a Gobblin’ Hog travels its full Move
distance before hitting with a melee attack, the target
must make a Str Stat Check. On Fail, the target gains the
Take Down Debuff. The target has Advantage to Evade
this move‑attack combo.
Night Hunter—The Int and Dex mod of Gobblin’ Hogs flip
at night, becoming Int (+4) and Dex (+1), with Surprise
14+F and Evade 11+F.
Nocturnal—Gobbln’ Hogs can see in nonmagical darkness.
Swamp Native—Gobblin’ Hogs can travel through
swampy terrain such as water, mud, and underbrush with
no penalty to their Move or Step.

name: Krasue
details:
Bite: 15+F to hit, 2d6+2 Piercing, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Blood Drain Debuff: Take
1d8+F Necrotic at the end of each round and the
Krasue attaches to the crawler and heals 1 HB slot, until
the Krasue is killed or removed. If the Krasue remains
attached for two or more successive rounds, the
crawler gains the Woozy Debuff.
Strangle: 15+F to hit, 3d8+2 Bludgeoning, 15ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Held Debuff.
Notes: Flight—Krasue move through the air as though
on the ground and can hover in place.
Ghostly—Krasue can only be harmed by magic or
enchanted items.
I Can Show You the World—Targets hit by a Krasue’s
Strangle attack are Held by their entrails and lifted 5ft
into the sky. The Krasue’s Step is reduced to 5ft and
Move to 10 while holding a creature in this manner,
and they’ll typically fly straight upward after grabbing a
creature until they reach a deadly height to drop them.
To escape, a crawler with the I Can Show You the World
Debuff must make a Str‑Opposed Escape Artist Skill
Check, or a Str Stat Check at the same Difficulty.

name: Merry Caroler
details: Don?t Rest Ye Merry Gentle Elves Spell: 14+F to hit, No damage, 30ft Burst radius. Any hit crawler gains the You?ll Listen to Us and Like It Debuff. Have You Ever Seen the Rain? Spell: 14+F to hit, 3d6+5 Ice, 60ft range. Jingle Balls Spell: 14+F to hit, 3d6+5 Bludgeoning, 60ft range. Shattering High Note Spell: 14+F to hit, 2d6+4 Sonic, 5ft Burst radius. Silent Night Spell: 14+F to hit, No damage, 50ft Burst radius. Space Oddity Spell: 14+F to hit, 2d6+4 Force, 40ft range, 10ft Blast radius. See the Core Rulebook for full effects.

name: Village Guard
details:
Commanding Shout Spell: 15+F to hit, No damage,
100ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Terrified Debuff for 2 rounds.
Longsword: 16+F to hit, 7d8+6 Slashing, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Notes: Letter of the Law—Village Guards don’t
compromise or show mercy. If they know someone has
broken a law, they attempt to kill the target on sight.
They end their pursuit if the target leaves the settlement
but remember the target if they return.

name: Demon
details:
Bite: 15+F to hit, 4d8+5 Piercing, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains The Taint Debuff for 2 rounds.
Unsaintly Claws: 15+F to hit, 5d6+5 Slashing, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Poisoned Debuff.
Notes: Not So Jolly—When they first encounter a
demon, crawlers must make an Int Stat Check. On Fail,
the crawler gains the Terrified Debuff.

name: Big Daddy Nick
details:
Bowie Knife: 14+F to hit, 3d4+4 Slashing, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Candy Shot: 15+F to hit, 3d6+5 Piercing, 100ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Sugar Rush Debuff: Take 1d8+F Poison damage each
round until the end of combat (stackable). Allows a free
Move action each round, but all Moves must be for the
full possible distance. If a crawler Moves twice in one
round as per the Debuff, they lose the Sugar Rush Debuff
and gain the Sugar Crash Debuff until end of combat: No
Stat Mods added to rolls, ends if Sugar Rush Debuff is
regained.
Triple Treat: 15+F to hit, 3d6+5 Fire, 60ft range, 10ft
Blast radius
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Staggered Debuff.
Notes: Delusional—Crawlers can make an Int‑Opposed
Deception Skill Check to convince Big Daddy Nick an
alien invasion is imminent. On Success, Big Daddy Nick
gains the Enraged Debuff.
Survivalist’s Stash—Big Daddy Nick keeps improvised
grenades in camouflaged nets attached to the roof of his
cabin. These grenades can be targeted with an attack
with an Evade of 10+F to hit and made to drop, dealing
3d6 Fire and exploding in a 20ft Burst radius around Nick
and his minions if they are led under them (they don’t
expect the explosion so they don’t Evade).

name: Shambling Berserker
details:
Grab: 15+F to hit, 3d8+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Held Debuff.
Slam: 15+F to hit, 3d10+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler is pushed 15ft.
Notes: Night Berzerking—Shambling Berzerkers are 4×
more powerful at night. When the sun goes down, their
Con and Str Mods and Move are all 4× higher.
Shambling Pack—Shambling Berzerkers travel in packs.
If two or more Shambling Berzerkers are adjacent to a
crawler, the crawler has Disadvantage to Evade.
Tenacious—Once a Shambling Berzerker has targeted a
crawler it does not stop until it has been destroyed or the
crawler has been killed.

name: Rumble Weed
details:
Bite: 15+F to hit, 3d6+5 Piercing, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff. This attack may only be made at night.
Trample: 15+F to hit, 2d10+5 Bludgeoning, 30ft Line
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Staggered and Take Down Debuffs.
Notes: Night Predator—At night Rumble Weeds can track
crawlers, gaining Advantage on their first attack of the combat.

name: Ruin Flocker
details:
Claw: 14+F to hit, 2d6+4 Slashing, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Slam: 14+F to hit, 2d6+4 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Take Down Debuff.
Trample: 13+F to hit, 1d6+4 Bludgeoning, 25ft Line
Any hit crawler gains the Staggered Debuff.
Notes: What the Flock—When 3 or more Ruin Flockers
are within 10ft of a crawler, coordinate Trample Attacks,
causing the crawler to suffer Disadvantage to Evade for
attacks when surrounded.
“Before Scolopendra turned the whole Over City into a graveyard, this was
the best place to find choice body parts. Now the body parts find you…”
—Under Tucker, Hobgoblin Undertaker

name: Hobgoblin Mortuarty Assistant
details:
Cleaning Spray: 14+F to hit, 1d6+4 Acid, 15ft Cone
Any crawler who fails to Evade gains the Poisoned
Debuff.
Scalpel: 14+F to hit, 2d6+4 Piercing, 5ft range, Ar‑
mor‑Piercing
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Notes: Death by a Thousand Cuts—When two or more
Hobgoblin Mortuary Assistants are adjacent to a target,
and the target has no adjacent allies, the target has Dis‑
advantage to Evade.

name: Hobgoblin Undertaker
details:
Cleaning Spray: 14+F to hit, 2d6+4 Acid, 15ft Cone
Any crawler who fails to Evade gains the Poisoned Debuff.
Scalpel: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Slashing, 5ft range, Armor‑
Piercing
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Notes: Lead to Death—When two or more Hobgoblins
are adjacent to a target, and the target has no adjacent
allies, the target has Disadvantage to Evade.

name: The Dispenser
details:
Aerial Slam: 16+F to hit, 3d10+6 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Take Down Debuff.
Caustic Mist: 15+F to hit, 3d8+4 Acid, 20ft Cone +10ft
Splash
Any crawler who fails to Evade gains the Burned Debuff.
Tail Whip: 16+F to hit, 5d6+6 Slashing, 10ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Staggered Debuff.
Notes: Camouflage—The Dispenser has Advantage on
its attacks during the first round of combat.
The Dispenser dispenses his attacks against crawlers in
pairs when able. If it is going to use Aerial Slam against a
crawler, it uses it as its first attack against that crawler.
Them’s Good Eatin’—The Dispenser will spend an action
to swallow any crawler that gains the Take Down Debuff
from Aerial Slam. The crawler must make a Str Stat
Check. On Fail, they have the Swallowed Debuff: They
take 1d10+F Acid at the end of each round until they
escape. To escape, they must make a Str‑Opposed Es‑
cape Artist Skill Check, or a Str Stat Check at the same
Difficulty. While Swallowed, The Dispenser’s DR does not
apply to that crawler’s attacks.
Big Head, But Beady Eyes—Attacks to The Dispenser’s
rear have Advantage.
Flight—The Dispenser can move through the air as
though on the ground.

name: Cool Kid
details:
Blue Steel Look: 14+F to hit, No damage, 20ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Paralyzed Debuff.
Icy Touch: 13+F to hit, 3d4+3 Ice, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Stiff Legs Debuff.
Slam: 13+F to hit, 3d6+3 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Take Down Debuff.
Notes: Peer Pressure—Crawlers must make an Int
Stat Check prior to each attack against a Cool Kid. On
Fail, they have Disadvantage on their attack as they
contemplate joining the clique. On Success, they never
make this Check again.

name: Neo-Maxie-Zoom-Dweebie
details:
Calculated Risk: 15+F to hit, 3d6+5 Psychic, 10ft
range, 5ft Blast radius

name: Non-Sparkly Vampire
details:
Bite: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Piercing, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Drained Debuff: Take 1d6+F Necrotic at the end of each
round until the combat ends, and that Non‑Sparkly Vam‑
pire heals 1 HB.
Sing Spell: 13+F to hit, 3d4+3 Sonic, 25ft Cone
Any crawler who fails to Evade gains the Fatigued
Debuff.

name: Student Body
details:
Acid Breath: 14+F to hit, 2d6+4 Acid, 20ft Cone
Any crawler who fails to Evade gains the Queasy Debuff.
Grab: 15+F to hit, 3d6+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Held Debuff.
Notes: Enrolled—Crawlers who gain the Held Debuff
start becoming assimilated into the Student Body. They
must make a Str‑Opposed Escape Artist Skill Check, or a
Str Stat Check at the same Difficulty. On Fail, the crawler
begins moving with the Student Body, taking 1d8+F
damage each round until they Escape or the Mob is killed.

name: Sporto Teen Wolf
details:
Bite: 14+F to hit, 3d4+4 Piercing, 5ft range
(Secret!) On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler
gains the Lycanthropy Debuff: The crawler turns into
a Sporto Teen Wolf the following night. The Debuff is
removed if the crawler has the Dying Debuff.
Stick: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Bludgeoning, 10ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Take Down Debuff.
Wedgie: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Slashing, 5ft
range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the
crawler gains The Taint Debuff.
Get it!?
Notes: Silver Weakness—Sil‑
ver weapons do ×2 damage
to Sporto Teen Wolves,
bypass DR, and apply The
Taint Debuff.

name: Teen Bully
details:
Blue Magnum Look: 15+F to hit, No damage, 20ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Paralyzed Debuff.
Icy Touch: 15+F to hit, 3d8+5 Ice, 5ft range
Piercing Glare: 15+F to hit, 3d6+5 Piercing, 25ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Held Debuff.
Notes: Manipulative—Crawlers attempting Charis‑
ma‑based Skills against Steph do so with Disadvantage.

name: Yakov
details:
Bite: 16+F to hit, 5d8+6 Piercing, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Held Debuff.
Chewed Up: 16+F to hit, 3d6+6 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Sepsis Debuff. This attack may
only be made against Held crawlers.
Landmine Frisbee: 16+F to hit, 4d8 Force, 30ft range,
10ft Blast radius
Whistle Stop: 13+F to hit, 4d6+3 Sonic, 30ft
Burst radius
Any crawler who fails to Evade gains the Muted
Debuff. Can be used once per day.
Notes: Listen to Coach—Yakov can spend
an Action to coordinate attacks of the
Sporto Teen Wolves, granting any within
30ft Advantage on their next attack.
Take the Lead—A crawler can spend
an Action to make an Int Stat Check to
determine the pattern of the landmines.
On Success, Yakov is led into one and
takes 4d8 Fire damage. This can be
done only once per round.
We’re Cool—A crawler can make an
Int‑Opposed Deception Check at the be‑
ginning of combat to convince Yakov they
are with Steph. On Success, all crawlers
gain Advantage on their first attack.

details:

thing they were holding.

Piercing
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.

through the air as though on the ground.

details:
Knife: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Piercing, 5ft range, Armor‑
Piercing
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Desert Eagle: 14+F to hit, 3d6 Piercing, 50ft range
Any hit crawler is pushed 10ft.
Notes: Fanatical—Elven Enforcers are immune to fear,
charm, and mind‑affecting abilities.

name: Hangman’s Hawks
details:
Acid Blast Spell: 15+F to hit, 2d8+5 Acid, 15ft Cone +
5ft Splash
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Burned Debuff.
Explosive Charge: 14+F to hit, 2d6 Fire, 20ft range,
15ft Blast radius
Any crawler who fails to Evade gains the Queasy Debuff.

name: Peregrin Perch Prowlers
details:
Crossbow: 15+F to hit, 3d6 Piercing, 50ft range
Spear: 15+F to hit, 3d8+5 Piercing, 10ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Grab: 15+F to hit, No damage, 5ft range

Notes: Catch and Release—Held crawlers are flown up
30 feet and dropped the next round. To escape, they
must make a Str‑Opposed Escape Artist Skill Check, or a
Str Stat Check with the same Difficulty.
Flight—Peregrin Perch Prowlers can move through the
air as though on the ground.
Riled Up—During the first round of combat, add their
Stat Mod to the damage a second time.

name: Skyfowl Crowcorps
details:
Dagger Feathers: 14+F to hit, 3d4+4 Piercing, 5ft
range, Armor‑Piercing

Blood Trail Debuff.
Gusty Winds Spell: 15+F to hit, 2d6+4 Bludgeoning,
30ft Cone +10ft Splash
Any crawler who loses 2+ HB slots gains the Take Down
Debuff.

name: Captain Raptor
details:
Cutlass: 16+F to hit, 5d8+6 Slashing, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler immediately
gains the Major Injury Debuff.
Fast Talking: 16+F to hit, No damage, 20ft Burst Radius
Any hit crawler must make an Int‑Opposed Detect Lies
Skill check or Int Stat Check at the same Difficulty. On
Fail, the crawler is enamored with Captain Raptor’s
birdshit words and can do nothing but listen until the
start of Captain Raptor’s next turn.
Flask Fling: 15+F to hit, 4d10+6 Bludgeoning, 10ft
range
Any hit crawler gains the Shit‑Faced Debuff.
Notes: Flight—Captain Raptor can move through the air
as though on the ground.
Lovable Liar—Captain Raptor gains Advantage on
Deception Checks.

name: Fowl Player
details: Berserk Howl: 16+F to hit, 6d10+6 Sonic, 40ft Burst radius. Fowl Hug: 16+F to hit, 6d12+6 Bludgeoning, 5ft range. Pounce: 16+F to hit, 6d10+6 Bludgeoning, 5ft range. Talon Strike: 16+F to hit, 7d12+6 Piercing, 5ft range, Armor-Piercing. See the Core Rulebook for full effects and notes.

details:

10ft Blast radius

Staggered Debuff.
Lightning Rod: 14+F to hit, 3d8+4 Electric, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Shocked Debuff.

Advantage on attacks when they are 10ft or more above
their target.
Brotherly Rage—404th Revolutionary City Elves gain
Advantage when attacking and Disadvantage when
Evading City Elves from the 201st.

name: Night Ray
details:
Barbed Spines: 14+F to hit, 3d4+4 Piercing, 30ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Poisoned and Blood Trail Debuffs.
Sting: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Piercing, 10ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Stunned Debuff.
Notes: Glimmering Hide—Night Rays have Resistance
to all Spell damage as their glimmering hide is able to
partially reflect them.
Gills—Night Rays can breathe underwater.
Glide—Night Rays can soar in the air up to half their
move each round.
Swim—Night Rays can move through the water as
though on the ground.

name: Scolopendrini
details:

Blood Trail Debuff.
Notes: Cold Weakness—Scolopendrini have Disadvan‑
tage to Evade Ice attacks and take × 2 damage from them.

name: Cyborg Mechanic
details:
Fast Disassemble: 15+F to hit, No damage, 10ft range
Any hit crawler must make a Dex Stat Check. On Fail, one
item the crawler is holding is disassembled and unusable
until they spend 2 Actions to reassemble it.
Monkey Wrench: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Bludgeoning,
10ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Staggered Debuff.
Multi-Weapon: 15+F to hit, 5d10+5 Bludgeoning,
Piercing, or Slashing (her choice), 10ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Woozy Debuff.
Notes: Identify Weakness—Helga Elfcrusher can spend
an Action to study a crawler and gains Advantage on her
next attack against them.

name: Kibril Atheras Darkoak
details:
Kinetic Blast: 16+F to hit, 6d10+6 Force, 50ft range
Choking Gas: 16+F to hit, 6d6+6 Poison, 30ft Cone
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Poisoned Debuff.
Deadly D4s: 16+F to hit, 7d4+6 Piercing, 30ft range

Fire Storm: 16+F to hit, 5d8+6 Fire, 50ft range, 20ft
Blast radius +10ft Splash
Any crawler who fails to Evade gains the Burned Debuff.

earth or stone walls to separate and isolate crawlers as
an action. This gives Kibril Altheras Darkoak Advantage
on their attacks against isolated crawlers.
Soul Crystal Shield—Kibril Altheras Darkoak has several
marble‑size soul crystals orbiting around him. They have
the same Evade as Kibril Altheras Darkoak, and if one is
hit, it disrupts Kibril Altheras Darkoak’ use of the ability for
one round. A crawler can make an Int‑Opposed Perception
Check or an Int Stat Check of the same Difficulty. On Suc‑
cess, the crawler can identify which soul crystals are used
for which effects. In addition, each time a crystal is hit, it
lowers his DR and Evade by 1 during the following round.

name: Former Circus Lemur
details:
Skinning Knives: 14+F to hit, 2d4+3 Piercing, 15ft
range, Armor‑Piercing
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Vicious Bites: 13+F to hit, 2d8+3 Piercing, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Sore as Shit Debuff.
Notes: Jumpy—Former Circus Lemurs can jump a
distance equal to twice their Move as an Action by
swinging off a ledge, lamp post, or giraffe’s neck.
Stealthy—Former Circus Lemurs do not appear on a
crawler’s mini‑map until the Lemur has initiated an attack.

name: Giraffe
details:

Blood Trail Debuff.
Hail of Lemurs: 13+F to hit, No damage, 30ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Held Debuff. Can be used twice
per combat.
Notes: Burst of Speed—Giraffes can take one free Move
Action once per combat.
Disruption—After using Burst of Speed to get close to
target, Giraffes can divide enemy groups by dropping
2d6 Former Circus Lemurs among them.

name: Stilt Clown
details:
Arm Whip: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Bludgeoning, 10ft range
Any hit crawler is pushed 10 feet.
Butcher Knife: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Slashing, 10ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Notes: Freakish Smile—Crawlers who move within 10ft
of a Stilt Clown for the first time must succeed at an Int
Stat Check. On Fail, they gain the Terrified Debuff.
Rubbery Arms—Stilt Clowns can stretch their arms and
head to twice their normal length as part of an attack.
The range of their next attack, however, is limited to 5ft
as their arms quickly retract.

Muted Debuff.
Notes: Freakish Smile—Crawlers who move within 10ft
of a Stilt Clown for the first time must succeed at an Int
Stat Check. On Fail, they gain the Terrified Debuff.
Roiling Belly—Fat Clowns have stomachs that rumble
and shift, making them immune to Poisoned.

details:

Any hit crawler gains the Terrified Debuff.

tacks when two or more are adjacent to the same target.

details:

Any hit crawler gains the Mental Intrusion Debuff: Para‑
sites begin talking directly into the crawler’s mind, giving
them the Queasy and Staggered Debuffs.

20ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler is pulled
10ft and gains the Held Debuff.
Notes: I Got Better—If Heather is healed by a crawler,
her attacks are made with Disadvantage in the following
round.
Unbearable—If Heather fails to deal any damage during
a round of combat, she gives up and asks to be put out
of her misery.

name: Ringmaster Grimaldi
details:
Commanding the Retinue: 17+F to hit, No dam‑
age, 50ft range
Any hit crawler has 3d6 of Grimaldi’s minions (For‑
mer Circus Lemurs, Giraffes, Mold Lions, Clowns, and
Ogres) appear and attack them.
Mental Link: 17+F to hit, No damage, 100ft
Burst radius
Any hit crawler gains the Mental Intrusion
Debuff: Grimaldi shares a collective conscious‑
ness with those infected by his parasites. He can speak
directly into their minds, see their memories, and even
attempt to exert a “mental tug” to stop their actions.
Crawlers must make an Int Stat Check. On Fail, they gain
the Paralyzed Debuff. Crawlers can attempt this Check
again once per round.
Vinally Yours: 17+F to hit, 6d10+7 Piercing, 100ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Vined For Good Debuff: The crawler gains the Blood Trail
and Sepsis Debuffs as vines begin growing from and
through their body.
Notes: Elite “Plot Armor”—Grimaldi remains “center
stage” in the big top arena, where his performers continue
to act out a parody of their original circus routines while
ignoring outside threats unless specifically engaged.
Rounded Up—Grimaldi takes ×4 damage from Poison.
Sentimental—Grimaldi has Disadvantage on all attacks
for the round the first time Signet is mentioned to him. If
Signet is allied with the crawlers and fighting with them,
the number of attacks Grimaldi can make is reduced by 2
for the first three rounds.

name: Mimic
details:
Bite: 15+F to hit, 3d8+5 Piercing, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Tongue Lash: 15+F to hit, 3d8+5 Bludgeoning, 10ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Held Debuff.
Notes: Stealthy—Any Mimic that is not surprised attacks
with Advantage during the first round of combat.
Twice Bitten—Mimics gain Advantage on their Bite attack
against crawlers with the Held Debuff. If Mimics succeed
on their Bite first attack against a crawler with the Held
Debuff, they gain a second attack at Disadvantage.

name: Drek
details:
Bite: 13+F to hit, 2d6+3 Piercing, 5ft range, Armor‑Piercing
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.

Any hit crawler gains the Sore as Shit Debuff.

to attach themselves to any crawler with the Blood Trail
Debuff. The crawler must make a Str‑Opposed Escape
Artist Skill Check. On Fail, the Drek attaches to the crawl‑
er and the Blood Trail Debuff damage increases by 1d4
each round. When attached, a Drek no longer attacks.
Swarming Behavior—Dreks travel in packs of 50 or more.
When 10 or more attack the same crawler, the crawler
has Disadvantage on all Evade Checks against all Drek.
Wall Walker—Dreks can move along vertical surfaces
and upside down on ceilings as though on the ground.

details:
Broom Bash: 15+F to hit, 3d8+5 Bludgeoning, 10ft range

On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Poisoned Debuff.
Sweep: 15+F to hit, 3d4+5 Bludgeoning, 10ft range
Any hit crawler is pushed 10ft.
Notes: Blood Sense—Jikininki gain Advantage on Perception
Checks to detect any crawler with the Blood Trail Debuff.
Janitor Mob—This Mob is responsible for cleaning
messes on Floor 4 and prioritizes cleaning up corpses. It
attacks crawlers when provoked, or when crawlers have
the Blood Trail Debuff.

name: Flesher
details:
Boned Spell: 13+F to hit, No damage, 5ft range
This ability can only be used on Skeletons. Any hit
skeleton becomes animated and under the control of the
Flesher.
Smother: 14+F to hit, 2d4+4 Acid, 10ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Burned and Held Debuffs.
Notes: Fire Immunity—Fleshers take no damage from Fire.
Re-Sleeving—When a Flesher attacks and consumes a
Symbiote, it becomes a more intelligent and powerful
Symbiote.
Symbiote Formation—When a Flesher successfully
animates a skeleton, the two combined entities become
a Symbiote.
War Mage—If a Symbiote is Re‑Sleeved at least a dozen
time, it becomes sapient and fuses into a single powerful
being known as a War Mage.

name: Grease Gremilin
details:
Fast Disassemble: 14+F to hit, No damage, 5ft range
Any hit crawler has one carried or worn mechanical de‑
vice (usually a weapon or piece of armor) disassembled
and made unusable until the crawler spends two actions
to reassemble it.
Multi-Weapon: 14+F to hit, 3d6+4 Bludgeoning, Pierc‑
ing, or Slashing (their choice), 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Minor Injury Debuff.
Notes: Fast Assembly—A Grease Gremlin can repair a
mechanical device in one third the normal time.
Irritable Worker—A Grease Gremlin ignores crawlers
while the Grease Gremlin is repairing items. When a
crawler disrupts their repair work, a Grease Gremlin
gains Advantage on their first attack against that crawler.

name: Shade Gnoll
details:

5ft range

Staggered Debuff.

Any hit crawler gains the Burned Debuff.
Pressure Point: 15+F to hit, 2d6+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft
range
Any hit crawler gains the Paralyzed or Take Down Debuff
(Shade Gnoll’s choice).
Notes: Pack Hunters—When two or more Shade Gnolls are
adjacent to a target, they gain Advantage on their attacks.
Riot Shields—Two or more Shade Gnolls equipped with a
Riot Shield can each spend their Move to form a movable
wall. Each Shade Gnoll in the wall gains Advantage to
Area of Effect and Evade Checks while part of the wall
but also gain Disadvantage on all their attacks.

name: Hobgoblin Interdictor
details:
Spanner: 14+F to hit, 2d8+4 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Staggered Debuff.
Improvised Explosive: 14+F to hit, 2d8
Fire, 20ft range, 10ft Blast radius
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the
crawler gains the Burned Debuff.
Notes: Creative—Hobgoblins gain
Advantage on all Explo‑
sives and Repair related
Checks.

name: Dwarf Employee
details:
Clipboard: 14+F to hit, 5d4+4 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Enraged Debuff.
Conducting: 15+F to hit, No damage, 10ft Burst radius
Any hit crawler gains the Compliant Debuff: The crawler
must make a Cha Stat Check. On Fail, the crawler must
obey the Dwarf Conductor’s next command.
Unarmed Attack: 14+F to hit, 5d4+4 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Stunned Debuff.
Notes: Pre-Production Stupor—When a Dwarf
Conductor completes their line, they blink out and
reset at the depot or station. They are dazed and highly
suggestible until their next shift begins. Crawlers have
Advantage on Skill Checks and attacks against them
during this time.

name: Grapple
details:
Grab: 16+F to hit, 3d8+6 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Held Debuff.
Notes: Highly Suggestible—Grapples have Disadvantage
against all attempts to charm, deceive, or persuade them.
Squirrelly—Grapples left without direction for 8 hours or
more become restless and start behaving erratically. This
may include running around in circles, rearranging furniture,
and closely following crawlers and mimicking their actions.

details:

Acid Spit: 15+F to hit, 6d8 Acid, 50ft Cone
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Burned Debuff.
Bite: 18+F to hit, 5d8+8 Piercing, 30ft range, Ar‑
mor‑Piercing
Any hit crawler gains the Swallowed Debuff: The crawler is
swallowed whole. When an attack against the Mimic results in
an Amazing Success or better (or it dies), all crawlers remove
the Swallowed Debuff. Swallowed crawlers take 1d8+F Acid
at the end of each round. Swallowed crawlers attack with Dis‑
advantage vs. 0 DR, and Slashing attacks deal ×2 damage.
Shaken and Stirred: 18+F to hit, 6d8+8 Bludgeoning,
100ft Burst radius
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Take Down and Terrified Debuffs. Only uses this every
other round.
Notes: Down and Out—Station Mimics double their Str
mod for any damage done against a crawler that has the
Take Down Debuff.
Mimic Regeneration—When the Station Mimic takes 2+ HB in
damage, a piece of the Station Mimic is sliced off. This piece
grows legs and crawls back to the main body and reattaches
on the Station Mimic’s next turn. When it reattaches to the
main body, the Mimic regains Health Bar slots equal to half of
what was lost when the piece was sliced off. If returning piece
receives 1 HB or more of damage, it is destroyed.
Minions—Once per round as an action, the Station Mimic can
produce 3d8 car‑sized slobbering mouths each on centi‑
pede‑like legs (use the Level 20 Mimic, p. 432).

name: War Mage
details:
Elemental Attack Spell: 17+F to hit, 5d6+7 damage
(type depends on Spell Specialization, see below) 100ft
range, 10ft Blast radius
Cloud Attack Spell 17+F to hit, 4d8+7 damage (type
depends on Spell Specialization, see below), 100ft range,
20ft Blast radius
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Poisoned Debuff.
Pull Spell: 17+F to hit, 4d8+7 Bludgeoning, 100ft range
Any hit crawler is pulled up to 30ft in the direction of the
War Mage’s choosing.
Skin Peel: 17+F to hit, 4d8+7 Slashing, 60ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains The
Taint Debuff.
Notes: Sapient Moment of Destruction—Ten minutes
after death, a War Mage’s head will explode dealing 5d12
+7 Force damage, 100ft Burst radius. A crawler can tem‑
porarily delay this by putting the head in their inventory,
which pauses the 10‑minute timer.
Spell Specialization—War Mages have a specialty area
(such as Fire Spells, Force Spells, or Healing Spells) and
can cast any Spells in that area of specialization at
Rank 15.
What a Know-It-All—War Mages have access
to hundreds of different Spells and can spend
their move to recall one and then use it. War
Mages can cast virtually any Spell at Rank 10.
You’re Not Done Yet Spell—When cast on
a fallen crawler or Mob, it rips the flesh
from their body and creates a Flesher

name: Mantaur
details:
Claws: 16+F to hit, 5d8+6 Slashing, 10ft range
Grab: 16+F to hit, 4d8+6 Bludgeoning, 10ft range

Tripple Stomp: 16+F to hit, 5d10+6 Bludgeoning, 5ft range

their Move to use one set of arms to hold a crawler. The

Check. On Fail, the crawler gains the Held Debuff.

music similar in style and genre, Mantuars gain the Berserk
Buff: They gain an additional attack each round, but all
their attacks are at Disadvantage. In addition, attacks
against Mantuars gain Advantage while they are Berserk.
Magic Resistance—Mantuars are immune to Spells below
Rank 5, and also specifically immune to Magic Missile
below Rank 11.

details:

Any hit crawler gains the Held Debuff.

Any hit crawler must make a free Cha Stat Check. On
Fail, must spend their next Action attacking an ally.
Spit Spray: 16+F to hit, 4d10+3
Poison, 50ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse,
the crawler gains The Taint
Debuff.
Unnerving Screams: 16+F to hit, 4d8+3 Sonic, 60ft
Burst radius
Any hit crawler gains the Queasy Debuff.

flattering hairstyle, and if it gets messed up, they are
frantic. Any attack that results in an Amazing Success or
better causes all Held Debuffs to cease.
Fire Weakness—Krakaren Clones take ×2 damage from
Fire based attacks.
Lightning Immunity—Krakaren Clones have Immunity to
Electric damage.
Psychic Resistance—Krakaren Clones take no damage
from Psychic based attacks, but do gain the Stunned
Debuff when they are hit by Psychic damage.
Soft Goey Center—Krakaren Clones take ×2 damage
from Piercing attacks that hit their main body.
Tough Enough—Krakaren Clones have ×2 their DR
against attacks that do Ice or Force damage.

details:
Mind Devour: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Psychic, 30ft range
Head Butt: 15+F to hit, 5d6+5 Bludgeoning, 10ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Woozy Debuff. This attack can only be used in goat form.
Sweet Song: 15+F to hit, No damage, 40ft Burst radius
Any crawler who fails to Evade gains the Unconscious
Debuff: They are prone and cannot take actions. If they
take damage, they wake up.
Vitamin Shot: 15+F to hit, 4d6+5 Piercing, 5ft range,
Armor‑Piercing
Any hit crawler gains the Poisoned Debuff.
Notes: Transformational—When attacked, a Pooka trans‑
forms into a huge goat.

numbered, they can call upon Mobs that are their clients to

serk when a creature with the Blood Trail Debuff is within

ing ally from foe. They take a −2 penalty to hit and roll

Checks against Charmed Dreks.

surfaces and ceilings as though on the ground.
Warped by Magic—During a gender reveal, Charmed
Dreks can be mutated into a humanoid hybrid on the
Conga Line. When this happens, they go berserk,
attacking the nearest target without distinguishing
friend from foe. They also grow to Medium size unless

hit, one additional damage die, and traits determined
by Race:
Cretin/Igneous: Stony skin that grants Resistance to
Piercing and Slashing damage.

Fails to Evade its Bite.

per turns into a kilt.

30ft must make Int Stat Check. On Fail, they become

tions, sensing surface thoughts in a vague manner,
and taking 1d6+F Psychic damage each round. The

healing magic (Rank 10 or higher). Regeneration or similar
Skills make the crawler immune to this Debuff. A Potion

though on the ground, and their Move increases to 30.

King Ghiduckhra with a

doing 1d8+F Poison
per round. This Debuff
is stackable and only
removed with a Poison
Antidote.

name: Trash Knight
details:
Rebar Sword: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Slashing, 5ft range
Trash Lance: 15+F to hit, 4d12 Piercing, 10ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Staggered Debuff. Can only be
used when Mounted.
Notes: Mounted—When mounted on their flying ostrich‑
es, Trash Knights can move through the air as though on
the ground, and their Move increases to 30.

name: Gelatinous Boob
details:
Engulf: 15+F to hit, 4d6+5 Acid, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Swallowed Debuff: The crawler
is swallowed whole and cannot be attacked. When an
attack against the Gelatinous Boob results in an Amazing
Success or better (or it dies), all crawlers remove the
Swallowed Debuff. Swallowed crawlers take 1d8+F Acid
at the end of each round. Swallowed crawlers attack with
Disadvantage vs. 0 DR.

name: Tape Head
details:
Terrible Tunes: 16+F to hit, 5d6 Sonic, 20ft Cone
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Sepsis Debuff.

name: Blaster Master
details:
Rock On: 14+F to hit, 3d4 Sonic, 15ft Burst range
Any hit crawler gains the Stunned.

name: More Dread
details:
Huge-Ass Sword: 17+F to hit, 7d10+7 Slashing, 10ft range
Crushing Step: 17+F to hit, 6d6+7 Bludgeoning, 10ft
Burst Radius
Any hit crawler gains the Take Down Debuff.
Just Dreadful: 16+F to hit, No damage, 30ft Burst radius
Any hit crawler gains the Terrified Debuff.
Notes: Split the Party—More Dread can spend his Move
to decouple the subway cars. A crawler on the subway
car must make a Dex Stat Check to avoid falling off the
car. On Fail, the crawler falls and takes 5d6 Bludgeoning.
Gristles, come out
and play!
—Lobe Ganger

name: Bomb Tosser
details:
Chomp: 14+F to hit, 5d8+5 Piercing, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Drop the Bomb: 15+F to hit, 2d8 Force, 30ft range, 10ft
Blast radius
Any crawler who fails to Evade gains the Staggered Debuff.

name: Mellow Surfer
details: High Five: 152+F to hit, 5d4+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range

name: Giant Frenzied Gerbil
details:
Scratch: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Slashing, 5ft range
Gnaw: 15+F to hit, 5d6+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Sepsis Debuff.
Notes: Frenzied—Frenzied Gerbils have a Step distance
of 20ft instead of 10ft.

name: Nerodia Water Snake
details:
Bite: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Piercing, 5ft range
Constrict: 15+F to hit, 3d6+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Held Debuff.
Swallow: 15+F to hit, 3d12+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
This attack may only be made against Held foes. Any hit
crawler gains the Swallowed Debuff: Swallowed crawlers
take 1d10+F Acid at the end of each round and cannot
be attacked. Swallowed crawlers attack with Disadvan‑
tage vs. 0 DR, and Slashing attacks deal ×2 damage.
When an attack against the Nerodia Water Snake results
in an Amazing Success or better (or it dies), all crawlers
remove the Swallowed Debuff.

name: Yard Beetle
details:
Slam: 15+F to hit, 5d6+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Take Down Debuff.
Trample: 15+F to hit, 4d6+5 Bludgeoning, 15ft Line
Any hit crawler gains the Sore as Shit Debuff.

name: Yard Mantis
details:
Bite: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Piercing, 5ft range
Spinning Scythe: 15+F to hit, 4d6+5 Slashing, 5ft
Burst radius
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Notes: Sudden Burst—Any Mantis that is not surprised
can travel twice its Move in the first round of combat.

name: Yard Spider
details:
Fangs: 15+F to hit, 4d6+5 Piercing, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Poisoned Debuff.
Leg Sweep: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Bludgeoning, 10ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Take Down Debuff.

name: Roller Derby Jammer
details:
Body Check: 15+F to hit, 5d8 + 5 Bludgeoning, 5ft
range
If the Roller Derby Jammer moved 10ft this round, any hit
crawler gains the Take Down Debuff.
Notes: Skater—While moving on skates, foes attack the
Roller Derby Jammer with Disadvantage.

name: Giant Frenzied Gerbil
details:
Scratch: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Slashing, 5ft range
Gnaw: 15+F to hit, 5d6+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Sepsis Debuff.
Notes: Frenzied—Frenzied Gerbils have a Step distance
of 20ft instead of 10ft.

name: Legion, the Feral Rat King
details:
Burrow Lunge: 16+F+F to hit, No damage, 20ft range
Legion disappears beneath the trash, erupting next to a
crawler anywhere in the pit. If the crawler fails to Evade
this lunge, the Boss makes a free Rabid Chomp attack.
Rabid Chomp: 16+F+F to hit, 5d6+6+F Piercing, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains The
Taint Debuff.
Trash Thrash: 16+F+F to hit, 3d8+6+F Bludgeoning,
30ft Cone
Any crawler who fails to Evade gains the Queasy Debuff.
Notes: Knot the Solution—A crawler can make a Dex‑
Opposed Ropework Skill Check to untie the tails. Doing so
reduces Legion’s DR to 0, and they spread out.
Naught But Cheese—Hitting one of the rats with a
quarter‑pound hunk of cheese (via the Throwing
Skill) deals no damage,
but it does reduce
the number of
Actions the Boss gets
during the following
round by 1.
Not of One Mind—
Area Attacks roll with
Advantage against Legion,
as the multiple heads each try to
dive in a different direction.
Feral—All to‑hit and damage values
include an extra +F (included
above).

name: Male Thorny Devil
details:
Chomp: 15+F to hit, 5d6+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Walking Pincushion: 15+F to hit, 4d6+5 Piercing, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Blood Trail Debuff.
Notes: Spikes All Over—On a melee attack Near Miss Fail
against this Mob, the crawler takes 2d6+F Piercing damage.
Add 1 die for each degree of Failure worse than that.

name: Thorny Devil Queen
details:
Chomp: 16+F to hit, 5d8+6 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Fiendish Flop: 15+F to hit, 4d6+6 Piercing, 10ft Burst radius
Any hit crawler gains the Held Debuff, and the Skewered
Debuff: Each failed escape from being Held subjects the
crawler to Spikes All Over (see below).
Notes: Spikes All Over—On any melee attack (or at‑
tempt to escape being Skewered) Near Miss Fail against
this Mob, the crawler takes 2d8+F Piercing damage. Add
1 die for each degree of failure worse than that.

name: Razor Fox
details:
Ninjato: 15+F to hit, 5d8+4 Slashing, 5ft range
Throwing Star: 16+F to hit, 4d6+4 Piercing, 30ft range
Notes: Outfoxy—Razor Foxes can also wield other ninja
equipment like smoke bombs, poison, or climbing claws.

name: Pazuzu Punk
details:
Guitar Smash: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft
range
Molotov Cocktail: 14+F to hit, 3d6 Fire, 25ft range,
10ft Blast radius
Any hit crawler gains the Burned Debuff.
Tail Strike: 15+F to hit, 4d6+5 Piercing, 10ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Poisoned Debuff.

name: Pazuzu Bootlicker
details:
Pincers: 15+F to hit, 4d8+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Held Debuff.
Tail Strike 15+F to hit, 4d6+5 Piercing, 10ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Poisoned Debuff.

name: Purifier Vulture
details:
Feeling Peckish: 14+F to hit, 5d8+4 Piercing, 5ft range
Searing Blast: 16+F to hit, 4d6+6 Fire, 100ft range,
10ft Blast radius
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Burned Debuff.
Notes: Flight—Can move through the air as if it were on
the ground.

name: Pistol Pangolin
details:
Pistoleg: 15+F to hit, 5d8 Piercing, 50ft range
Roly-Poly: 15+F to hit, 4d6+5 Bludgeoning, 25ft Line
Any crawler who fails to Evade slides 5 feet in a direction
of the GM’s choice.

name: Razor Fox
details:
Katana: 15+F to hit, 5d8+4 Slashing, 5ft range
Throwing Star: 16+F to hit, 4d6+4 Piercing, 30ft range
Notes: Outfoxy—Razor Foxes can also wield other ninja
equipment like smoke bombs, poison, or climbing claws.

name: Phosphenmenologist
details:
Pillow Fight: 14+F to hit, 5d6+6 Bludgeoning, 30ft range
On hit, target gains the Fatigued Debuff

name: Sangoma
details:
Shuriken: 15+F to hit, 5d4+3 Piercing, 40ft range
Heal Others: Target heals 2d6 HB, 30ft range
Notes: Divining the Truth—Once per long rest, the Sangoma
can look into the future and choose to give themselves or a
party member Advantage on their next Evade check.

name: Girtablullu
details:
Litigate Spell: 17+F to hit, 7d8+7* Psychic, 100ft range
*Before damage is rolled, the target has the option to
“settle” and take the average damage of the dice (39)
instead of having it rolled.
Pincers: 17+F to hit, 6d8+7 Bludgeoning, 10ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Held Debuff.
Tail Strike: 17+F to hit, 6d6+7 Piercing, 15ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Poisoned Debuff.
Notes: Care for an Argument?—A crawler can exploit
Girtablullu’s propensity to argue. The crawler must make
Int‑Opposed Deception Skill Check. On Success, Girt‑
ablullu loses 2 Actions in the following round. After this
happens twice, the Boss asks for a continuance and the
AI grants it, negating further use of this ability.
Objection!—Once he falls to 40% HB or less, Girtablullu
can yell “Objection!” as an Interrupt Action. One, and
only one, crawler must make an Int Stat Check vs. Dif‑
ficulty 22 (unless someone has a Lawyer Up Skill). On
Fail, each crawler loses one Action that round. Girtablullu
can do this only twice per combat. On Success, the ob‑
jection is overruled by the AI, and they gain the Litigant
Pro Se achievement.
Poison Blood—If Girtablullu loses 2+ HB slots from a
melee attack, the crawler gains the Poisoned Debuff.
Professional Courtesy—Crawlers holding a legal text in
one hand roll Evade Checks with Advantage.

name: City Elf Trapper
details:
Hunting Knife: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Slashing, 5ft range
Duck Call: 15+F to hit, 4d6 Sonic, 15ft Cone
Any hit crawler attracts the attention of an annoying duck,
who pecks at the crawler’s ears and ankles (the crawler
gains the Sore as Shit Debuff). Any attack against the
duck that is not a Critical Fail kills or scares it off.

name: City Elf Mechanic
details:
Wrench: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Explosive Exit: 15+F to hit, 4d6 Fire, 10ft Burst radius
Any hit crawler gains the Burned Debuff. A City Elf
Mechanic uses this if at 20% HB or less, and only if the
crawlers outnumber them. Then the Elf dies.
Notes: See Patterns—City Elf Mechanics can see invis‑
ible entities. If crawlers are benefiting from the Tactics
Skill, those effects last for only one round.

name: Elven Clear-Cutter
details:
Buzzsaw: 14+F to hit, 4d8+6 Slashing, 5ft Burst radius
Arm Blades: 16+F to hit, 5d6+6 Slashing, 15ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Notes: Many-Armed—Elven Clear‑Cutter may spend its
Move Action to attack.

name: Pterolykos Hunter
details:
Claw: 15+F to hit, 5d6+5 Slashing, 5ft range
Mom’s Rifle: 15+F to hit, 4d8 Piercing, 200ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Blood Trail Debuff.
Notes: Aerial Ambush—Each Pterolykos Hunter that
is not surprised attacks with Advantage during the first
round of combat.

name: Pterolykos Elder
details:
Claws: 15+F to hit, 5d6+5 Slashing, 5ft range
Rifle: 15+F to hit, 4d8 Piercing, 200ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Blood Trail Debuff.
Notes: Aerial Ambush—Each Pterolykos that is not
surprised attacks with Advantage during the first round
of combat.

name: Human Swashbuckler
details:
Saber: 15+F to hit, 5d6+5 Slashing, 5ft range
Blunderbuss: 15+F to hit, 4d8 Piercing, 25ft Cone
Any crawler who fails to Evade gains the Blood Trail
Debuff.

name: Human Gunslinger
details:
Punch: 15+F to hit, 5d6+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
NES Zapper: 15+F to hit, 4d8 Force, 40ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Blood Trail Debuff.

name: Propper
details:
Dive Bomb: 15+F to hit, 5d6+5 Fire, 30ft range, 10ft
Blast radius
Propper only uses this explosive attack during the first
round of the combat, or when at 50% HB or less, when
he will use it at least once per round.
Downwash: 15+F to hit, 6d10+5 Force, 60ft range, 20ft Splash
Any hit crawler slides 5ft for each HB slot lost. (Splash is
half damage, and this is all Splash.)
Propeller Blast: 15+F to hit, 7d8+5 Force, 60ft range
Any hit crawler is pushed 5ft for each HB slot lost.
Notes: Flying High—Propper remains 60ft off the
ground, making melee weapons nearly useless.
Jammed—To jam a rotor, a sturdy object of at least
Petite (3) size must be used. If any of its propellers are
jammed, Propper immediately loses 2 HB slots and 20
feet of altitude.
Off the Cliff—If a crawler falls over the cliff edge, they
fall for two rounds and can perform actions before
SPLAT (Death!).

name: Pet Ghast
details:
Bite: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Necrotic, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Poisoned Debuff.
Putrid Vomit: 14+F to hit, 3d6 Acid, 15ft Cone
Any hit crawler gains the Acid Debuff: Takes 1d8+F Acid
at the end of each round for 2 rounds.
Notes: New Unlife—When a foe dies to one of the above
attacks, it becomes a Ghast and joins the commune.

name: Ghommid
details:
Claw: 16+F to hit, 5d8+6 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Intestinal Tentacle: 15+F to hit, 4d6+6 Bludgeoning,
10ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Held Debuff.

name: Igneous
details:
Stones Throw: 14+F to hit, 5d8+5 Bludgeoning, 30ft range
Rocky Rumble: 15+F to hit, 4d6+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Any hit crawler is pushed 5 feet for every HB slot lost.
Notes: Hot Stuff—When a crawler adjacent to an
Igneous makes two attacks in a round, they take
1d10+F Fire damage.

name: Night Elf Hunter
details:
Katana: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Slashing, 5ft range
Crossbow: 14+F to hit, 3d8 Piercing, 30ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Blood Trail Debuff.
Notes: UV Fungus—Night Elf Hunters increase their
damage die type to d10s instead of d8s vs the Undead.

name: Countess Kesla
details:
Pet Ghast Release Spell: A Ghast is released from the
wall, joining the combat.
Blood Boil Spell: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Necrotic, 50ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Fatigued Debuff.
Feral Bite: 16+F to hit, 5d6+6 Piercing, 5ft range
For every 2 HB slots lost to this attack, Countess Kesla
heals 1 HB slot.
Notes: Blood Makes Noise—At 60% and at 20% or less
HB, Countess Kesla gains 1 Action, typically to release
more Pet Ghasts to save her (if she has her pendant).
Pendant—A crawler may roll a melee attack with Disad‑
vantage to cut or swipe the pendant off her neck. If she
loses it, she can’t release any Pet Ghasts.

name: Big Boy Blue
details:
Sting: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Piercing, 30ft Line
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Poisoned Debuff.

name: Concierge Shark
details:
Bite: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Piercing, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Notes: Feeding Frenzy—If a shark‑foe drops to 50% HB
or less or gains the Blood Trail Debuff, Concierge Sharks
may use their Move Action to attack.

name: Juvenile Octo-shark
details:
Bite: 15+F to hit, 5d6+5 Piercing, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Blood Trail Debuff.
Tentacle: 15+F to hit, 3d6+5 Bludgeoning, 10ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Held Debuff.

name: Crocodilian Roid-Soldier
details:
Vicious Bite: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Piercing, 5ft range
Harpoon Gun: 15+F to hit, 3d6 Piercing, 30 ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Pinned to a Surface Debuff:
The crawler is Held against a surface like a wall, tree, or
whatever is nearby (the ground as a last resort).
Notes: Roid Rage—Buffs have triple the effect on
Roid‑Soldiers.

name: Giant Dragonfish
details:
Bite: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Piercing, 5ft range
Lure Spell: 14+F, No damage, 50ft range
Any hit crawler must spend actions moving until they are
adjacent to the Dragonfish.
Notes: Glowing Lure—The first time each crawler would
make a melee attack against the Dragonfish, if they don’t
say “I don’t look at the light,” they must make an Int Stat
Check. On Fail, they lose that action.

name: Crocodilian Mob Boss
details:
Vicious Bite: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Piercing, 5ft range
Harpoon Gun: 15+F to hit, 3d10 Piercing, 30 ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Pinned to a Surface Debuff:
The crawler is Held against a surface like a wall, tree, or
whatever is nearby (the ground as a last resort).
Notes: Boss’s Orders—At the beginning of each turn, the
Mob Boss points out a target, and that target suffers Dis‑
advantage on Evade Checks from the Boss’s underlings.

name: Lusca, Octo-Shark Brood Mother Queen
details:
Rush: 18+F to hit, 6d8+8 Bludgeoning, 50ft Line
Crawlers adjacent to Lusca can spend an Action as an
Interrupt to make a Str Stat Check when Lusca does a
Rush attack. On Success, they move with
Lusca and have Advantage on their next
attack. On Fail, the crawler does not move with her (and
may be in the Line path).
Bite: 18+F to hit, 5d10+8 Piercing, 15ft range
Any hit crawler ends up in Lusca’s ginormous mouth,
and gains the Fish Food Debuff: Take 1d12+F Piercing at
the end of each round. Interior attacks are vs. 0 DR.
Flipper: 18+F to hit, 6d10+8 Bludgeoning, 30ft range
Any hit crawler slides 5ft for each HB slot lost.
Notes: Mouth Sores—If any crawler deals 3+ HB slots of
damage to Lusca in one shot, the juvenile sharks cause
Lusca to lose 1 HB slot at the end of each round, and the
Fish Food Debuff is removed.

name: Bubble Beluga
details:
Air Bubble: 15+F to hit, 5d6+5 Force, 30ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Staggered Debuff.
Headbutt: 15+F to hit, 4d6+5 Piercing, 5ft range
The Bubble Beluga must be able to move 20ft in a
straight line toward the target to make this attack. Any
hit crawler is pushed 10 feet. If the target is a ship, all
aboard must make an Unopposed Balance Skill Check or
slide 5 feet toward the closest water space.

name: Cannonback Tortoise
details:
Grapeshot: 15+F to hit, 4d6 Piercing, 30ft Cone
Cannonball: 16+F to hit, 5d8 Bludgeoning, 50ft range
Any hit crawler is pushed 5 feet for each HB slot lost.
Self-Destruct: 15+F to hit, 4d12 Bludgeoning, 10ft
Burst radius
If the Cannonback Tortoise is reduced to 20% HB or less,
it blows itself up and dies.

name: Pain Amplifier Jellyfish
details:
Tentacles: 16+F to hit, 5d6+6 Piercing, 30ft Cone
Any hit crawler gains The Taint Debuff. On an Evade Ma‑
jor Fail or worse, the crawler gains the Shocked Debuff.

name: Pirate
details:
Cutlass: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Slashing, 5ft range
Pistol: 15+F to hit, 4d8 Piercing, 40ft range
Liquor Flamethrower: 15+F to hit 4d6+5 Fire, 15ft
Cone
The Pirate takes a swig of grog, lights a match, and blows
flame. Any hit crawler gains the Burned Debuff.
Notes: Ghostly—If the Pirate is Ghost, it can only be
harmed by enchanted weapons and Spells, and all its
attacks are considered magical for the purposes of over‑
coming Resistances and Immunities.

name: Admiral Stoma
details:
Dactyl Smash: 16+F to hit, 6d8+6 Bludgeoning, 5ft
range
If a crawler loses 4+ HB slots this way, they are thrown
overboard (through a window if need be).
Grappling Gun: 15+F to hit, 7d4 Piercing, 50ft range
Any hit crawler is pulled 15 feet toward Stoma.
Boil the Air: 15+F to hit, 4d6 Fire, 20ft Burst radius
Any hit crawler gains the Scalded Debuff: Take 1d8+F at
the end of each round for the next 2 rounds.
Notes: Overboard—Crawlers thrown overboard must
make an Unopposed Swimming Skill Check or gain the
Drowning Debuff. Make an Unopposed Climbing Skill
Check to get back up. If a rope ladder is lowered, roll
with Advantage.

name: Nude Glaber
details:
Claw: 13+F to hit, 5d6+3 Slashing, 5ft range
Gagging Gaze: 16+F to hit, 4d6+6 Force, 30ft range
Any hit crawler gains the You Stanky! Debuff: Disadvan‑
tage on all Charisma Skill Checks until you take a long
rest and wash up.
Notes: Re-Mole-deling—Heals 1 HB slot at the end of
each round, and regrows a limb if it takes no damage
during a round of combat.

name: Flesh Farrago
details:
Mushroom Stamp: 15+F to hit, 5d6+5 Bludgeoning,
5ft range
Spores: 12+F to hit, 3d8+2 Poison, 15ft Burst radius
Any crawler who fails to Evade gains the Woozy Debuff.
Notes: Fast-Growing—Heals 1 HB slot at the end of
each round.

name: Glimmermote Swarm
details:
Fade Away: 15+F to hit, 4d6+6 Psychic, 5ft range
On an Evade Fail or worse, the crawler gains the rath‑
er‑hard‑to‑remove Fading Debuff: A part of their body
turns a little transparent, like it’s slowly disappearing
from existence. At the end of each day that the crawler
has this Debuff, replace one of their External Buffs with
a +1 Evade Buff (some attacks pass through). Once all
three lines are filled, the crawler fades completely out of
existence at the end of the following day. This Debuff can
only be removed by a priest devoted to a deity of life… or
the deity itself.

name: Pudding Pal
details:
Pudding Punch: 15+F to hit, 5d8+5 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains a
Pudding Debuff (see below).
Pudding Blast: 15+F to hit, 3d6+5 Force, 25ft range,
5ft Blast radius
Any hit crawler gains a Pudding Debuff (see below).
Notes: Pudding Debuff—Each flavor of Pudding Pal gives
a different Debuff. Feel free to make up more of your own.
Lemon Pudding—Take 1d10+5 Acid at the end of each
round until the end of the combat.
Vanilla Pudding—Roll Charisma Skill Checks with Disad‑
vantage for the rest of the day.
Chocolate Pudding—You poop yourself. Don’t let any hit
the ground!
Butterscotch Pudding—Cannot take Steps until the end
of the combat.

name: Arachnid Grappler
details:
Grappling: 16+F to hit, 4d8+6 Bludgeoning, 5ft range
Any hit crawler gains the Held Debuff.
Web-Shooting: 15+F to hit, 5d6+6 Bludgeoning, 30ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the
Held Debuff.
Arachnid Arcanist. Level 50.
Arachnid Arcanists weave magic like other spiders
weave webs. That’s not metaphor; they literally spew
raw magic from their butts and weave it into different
Spells. Arcanists weaving together can create sorcery
so powerful that no lone caster could ever hope to
equal it. They created the Warding Weave, a shield
that supports the weight of centuries of Nude Glaber
excrement, and they did it while on the tail end of a
week‑long drug bender. That should tell you every‑
thing you need to know about their prowess.

name: Arachnid Arcanist
details:
Butt Blast Spell: 16+F to hit, 5d6+6 Necrotic, 30ft range
Any hit crawler gains the But, Butt, Buu… Debuff: The
crawler is marked until the end of combat. When hit by
this Spell again, it becomes a different random attack
Spell in every way (except range), dealing 5dX, and add‑
ing its Rank 10 Upgrade (if applicable).
“An endless abyss of pain
and suffering? Ha. That’s
just another Saturday
night at my house. Believe
me, I’m doing you a favor
by ending you now.”
—Kensington, Feral Pear Tree

name: Thing Too Horrible to Name
details:
Psychic Bolt Spell: 17+F to hit, 5d6+7, Psychic, 40ft
range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler gains the Ter‑
rified Debuff, seeing the thing that most torments them.

name: Kensington
details:
Branch Manager: 16+F+F to hit, 6d10+6+F Bludgeon‑
ing, 100ft range
On an Evade Major Fail or worse, the crawler falls into
a deep depression and can do nothing but stare blankly
into the abyss until the end of the current round.

age to the tower. Let the players know that the marble

mor‑Piercing
Grapple: 16+F to hit, 6d6+6 Bludgeoning, 5ft range

Avalanche Form—At 20% HB, it changes form into a living
avalanche, where it has Resistance to ALL damage types,

name: Crocodilian Clawpad
details:

Canidna
These canine creatures are nearly identical to wolves,
except for the jagged spines that cover nearly the
entirety of their back and their flanks. Their stiff spines
make melee attacks against them dangerous. Their
eyes are smaller than those of normal wolves and shine
darkly from within their narrow faces. However, their
lengthened snouts give them an excellent sense of smell.
They typically hunt in packs of three to seven. When
between one to three remain, it is not uncommon for
them to charge crawlers before rolling into a tight ball,
attempting to impale said crawlers with their strong
spines. These Mobs can only be found in the Pack Halls.

Pack Rats
These giant white rats range in size from that of an
ordinary rodent to that of a medium-sized dog. They
scurry about the Neighborhood, eating away at any
corpses left on the floor. Their fur varies in shades
of gray, but in the Pack Alley Palls, their fur is snow-
white, their bulging eyes as red as blood, and they
look almost excited to see the crawlers. These ghostly
Pack Rats appear more aggressive and intelligent, and
they make no noise as they scurry about, but they’re
otherwise identical to their more common kin.

noises, bright lights, or perceived insults can trigger an
immediate rage response. This doubles the Stat Mod
bonus to their damage rolls. In addition, Their chemical-
ly-fueled endurance allows them to push through pain and

20ft Blast radius

Firestrike Spell: 14+F to hit, 2d6+4 Fire, 30ft range
